bias.en: Bearish · rejected at $295.6 again, holding the 5-day
bias.zh: 看空 · 再度在 $295.6 受阻，守住 5 日均线

read.en: Alphabet fell 2.2% on Nov 5 to $282.57, trading between $277.07 and $295.60 on heavy volume. It is just above the falling 5-day ($282.1) and below the falling 10-day ($297.7), 30-day ($328.7), 100-day ($342.4) and 200-day ($339.7) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($303.92), and RSI is 28.
read.zh: Alphabet 11月5日下跌 2.2%，收于 $282.57，盘中区间 $277.07–295.60，成交量放大。股价略高于下行的 5 日均线（$282.1），并低于下行的 10 日（$297.7）、30 日（$328.7）、100 日（$342.4）和 200 日均线（$339.7）。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$303.92），RSI 为 28。

read.en: The $295.60 high failed again at the $294.1–296.5 resistance, and the close gave back the $283.4–283.8 area (Nov 4 low, Oct 29 close), now resistance; the 5-day held on the close. Resistance is $283.4–283.8, then $294.1–297.7 (Mar 9 low, Nov 4–5 highs, 10-day) and $303.9 (SAR). Support is $282.1 (5-day), then $276.9–277.2 (Oct 30, Nov 3 and Nov 5 lows) and $270.7–272.1. A close above $283.8 would target $294–298; below $276.9, $271.

r.en: Mar 9 low $294.1; Nov 5 high $295.6; Nov 4 high $296.5; 10-day average $297.7
